name: Structural steel ASTM A36 (hot rolled)
source_name: Wikipedia (Young's modulus; Ultimate tensile strength); Engineering ToolBox
notes: E=200 GPa and yield 250 MPa (UTS 400-550) from Wikipedia pages en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ultimate_tensile_strength; density 7820 is EngineeringToolbox generic 'steel' (density-solids-d_1265.html), not A36-specific. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (pig iron 0.42 USD/kg 2020 on Wikipedia Prices_of_chemical_elements; stock higher).

name: Stainless steel 304 (annealed, ASTM A240 minimum)
notes: Density 7.90 g/cm3, yield 205 MPa min (0.2%, ASTM A240 spec minimum, UTS 515 MPa min) from the ATI page; E 190-203 GPa (195 used) from https://www.azom.com/properties.aspx?ArticleID=965 which lists elastic limit 205-310 MPa. Spec minimum, so typical mill values (~215-260 MPa) are higher; typical value not verified from an opened page. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (reasoned; no price page opened).

name: Alloy steel 4340 (annealed)
notes: Annealed condition per page: yield 470 MPa, UTS 745 MPa, E 190-210 GPa (200 used). Quenched and tempered 4340 reaches ~740-1860 MPa yield (Wikipedia 4340_steel). Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (reasoned; no price page opened).

name: Aluminium 6061-T6
notes: Page gives typical yield 270 MPa (min 240), UTS 310 MPa, E 68-69 GPa (page inconsistent). Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (Al 1.79 USD/kg 2019 on Wikipedia Prices_of_chemical_elements; alloy stock higher).

name: Aluminium 7075-T6
notes: Page: yield at least 430-480 MPa (450 used), UTS 510-540 MPa, E 71.7 GPa, density 2.81 g/cm3. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (reasoned from Al price; unverified).

name: Titanium Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, annealed/typical)
notes: Page ranges: density 4429-4512, E 104-113 GPa, yield 880-920 MPa, UTS 900-950 MPa; mid values used. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (Ti 11 USD/kg 2020 per Wikipedia Prices_of_chemical_elements; mill product several times higher).

name: Magnesium AZ31B (extruded)
notes: Page: E 44.8 GPa, yield 200 MPa, UTS 260 MPa; temper not named for mechanical table (AZoM temper pages give 150-220 MPa yield). Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (Mg 2.32 USD/kg 2019 on Wikipedia Prices_of_chemical_elements).

name: Copper 99.9% (annealed)
notes: Density 8.935 g/cm3 at 20 C and E 110-128 GPa from the Copper page (110 used, annealed per en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Young%27s_modulus). The 8960 figure was not on the page. Yield 70 MPa, UTS 220 (99.9% Cu) from en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ultimate_tensile_strength. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (Cu 6.00 USD/kg 2019, Wikipedia Prices_of_chemical_elements).

name: Brass (generic, condition unspecified)
source_name: Engineering ToolBox (density); Wikipedia (Young's modulus; Ultimate tensile strength)
notes: Density 8400-8750 (8500 used), E 106 GPa, yield '200+' MPa, UTS 500; composition and temper unspecified so strength is a low-end figure. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (reasoned from Cu and Zn prices; unverified).

name: Inconel 718 (aged)
notes: Page: density 8.23 g/cm3, E 200 GPa, yield 1175 MPa, UTS 1395 MPa; condition not stated on page (typical aged). Other AZoM 718 pages give 1100-1175 MPa yield. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (reasoned from Ni 13.9 USD/kg 2019; unverified).

name: Grey cast iron (generic)
notes: E 130 GPa for grey cast iron per Engineering ToolBox (the 170 GPa on that page is a different, 4.5% C A-48 row); tensile strength 200 MPa (UTS) from en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ultimate_tensile_strength; brittle, so no meaningful yield; density 7200 from EngToolbox density-solids-d_1265.html. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude (reasoned; unverified).

name: HDPE
notes: E 0.97-1.38 GPa (1.1 used); yield 26-33 MPa, UTS 37 (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ultimate_tensile_strength); density 960 from EngToolbox density-solids-d_1265.html. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude; no price page opened (unverified). Cost update: HDPE resin about 1.1-1.5 USD/kg (USA 1.32 Sep 2026) per https://www.imarcgroup.com/hdpe-pricing-report (market-research site, indicative, order-of-magnitude).

name: PEEK (unfilled)
notes: Page: density 1.32 g/cm3, E 3.6 GPa, tensile strength 90-100 MPa. Cost indicative, 2026, order-of-magnitude; reasoned (PEEK is a premium polymer, tens to ~100 USD/kg); no price page opened (unverified).
